dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「おっ、今日は少し早いな」
dialogues.en: "Wow, you're actually early today!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, you're actually early today!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ほっとけ」
dialogues.en: "Stuff it."
dialogues.text: "Stuff it."

dialogues.jp:
見知ったクラスメイトと挨拶を交わし、まずは
自分の席に着く。
dialogues.en:
Exchanging "greetings" with a fellow classmate, I sat at my
desk.
dialogues.text:
Exchanging "greetings" with a fellow classmate, I sat at my
desk.

dialogues.jp:
音夢は教卓前の自分の席で、クラスの女友達と
話をしている。
dialogues.en:
Nemu, sitting in the front row, was chatting with her female
friends.
dialogues.text:
Nemu, sitting in the front row, was chatting with her female
friends.

dialogues.jp: 「あ〜、かったりい」
dialogues.en: "Haaaa, booooring..."
dialogues.text: "Haaaa, booooring..."

dialogues.jp: そのまま机に突っ伏す。
dialogues.en: I fell prostrate onto my desk.
dialogues.text: I fell prostrate onto my desk.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おっ、朝倉。朝から絶好調だな」
dialogues.en:
"Ohh, Asakura. This time you're actually prepared for the
morning."
dialogues.text:
"Ohh, Asakura. This time you're actually prepared for the
morning."

dialogues.jp:
杉並がいつものように、にかにかしながら俺の
元にやって来る。
dialogues.en:
The grinning Suginami, as always, approached my desk before
the class starts.
dialogues.text:
The grinning Suginami, as always, approached my desk before
the class starts.

dialogues.jp:
「お前は、これのどこが絶好調なように見える
　んだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where do you see any preparation here?"
dialogues.text: "Where do you see any preparation here?"

dialogues.jp:
近づいてはならない奴の、見本とも言うべき悪
友の顔を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
As he got closer, I looked up to the face of one of the best
examples of a worst friend.
dialogues.text:
As he got closer, I looked up to the face of one of the best
examples of a worst friend.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なに、いつも通りということさ」
dialogues.en: "The usual Asakura, I see!"
dialogues.text: "The usual Asakura, I see!"

dialogues.jp: ぽんぽん、と俺の肩を叩く杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami slapped my shoulder.
dialogues.text: Suginami slapped my shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
この軽薄さとノリで、実は学年トップの成績な
んだから、世の中、間違ってるよな。
dialogues.en:
Even though he acts so casual all the time, he's actually
has the top marks of the class, a blip in society.
dialogues.text:
Even though he acts so casual all the time, he's actually
has the top marks of the class, a blip in society.

dialogues.jp: しかも運動も球技全般ＯＫときてる。
dialogues.en: Even worse, he's good at pretty much all sports.
dialogues.text: Even worse, he's good at pretty much all sports.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ところで朝倉。素晴らしい企画があるのだが、
　お前も参加せんか？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way Asakura, I've come up with a magnificent
project. You'd participate in it, of course?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way Asakura, I've come up with a magnificent
project. You'd participate in it, of course?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「くだらない企画の間違いじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Wouldn't it be more like a stupid project?"
dialogues.text: "Wouldn't it be more like a stupid project?"

dialogues.jp: いや、こいつの場合は断定できるだろう。
dialogues.en:
Whenever it's from this guy, it always seems like that's the
case.
dialogues.text:
Whenever it's from this guy, it always seems like that's the
case.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことは無いぞ。『白河ことりが卒業ま
　でに何人に告白されるか？』という、素晴ら
　しいクイズ大会だ」
dialogues.en:
"Of course not. It's a wonderful quiz competition centered
around the question "How many people will confess to
Shirakawa Kotori before her graduation?""
dialogues.text:
"Of course not. It's a wonderful quiz competition centered
around the question "How many people will confess to
Shirakawa Kotori before her graduation?""

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……賭けの間違いじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "...What I said, in other words?"
dialogues.text: "...What I said, in other words?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何を言う。これはれっきとしたクイズ大会だ。
　むろん、正解者には豪華景品が進呈される」
dialogues.en:
"What are you talking about! Just look at the list of people
who've already signed up. Naturally, the person with the
correct answer will be awarded a spectacular prize."
dialogues.text:
"What are you talking about! Just look at the list of people
who've already signed up. Naturally, the person with the
correct answer will be awarded a spectacular prize."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: （豪華景品ねえ……）
dialogues.en: "(...Spectacular prize, eh...)"
dialogues.text: "(...Spectacular prize, eh...)"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今のところ、一番人気は５０〜６０人といっ
　たところだな」
dialogues.en:
"Right now, the most popular range is around the 50-60
mark."
dialogues.text:
"Right now, the most popular range is around the 50-60
mark."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ、凄いな」
dialogues.en: "That's amazing."
dialogues.text: "That's amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんといっても、白河ことりだからな。俺は
　大穴で、１００人は越すのではないかと思っ
　ている」
dialogues.en:
"Nah, it's Shirakawa Kotori after all. I'm going for a dark
horse bet, I think 100 people will confess to her by then."
dialogues.text:
"Nah, it's Shirakawa Kotori after all. I'm going for a dark
horse bet, I think 100 people will confess to her by then."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "100 people..."
dialogues.text: "100 people..."

dialogues.jp:
突拍子もない人数だが、彼女の人気を考えれば、
不可能な気がしない。
dialogues.en:
Even for that crazy amount of people, knowing her
popularity, I wouldn't say it's impossible...
dialogues.text:
Even for that crazy amount of people, knowing her
popularity, I wouldn't say it's impossible...

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「まったく、あんた達ってほんと、しょうがな
　いわね……」
dialogues.en: "Really, you two are hopeless..."
dialogues.text: "Really, you two are hopeless..."

dialogues.jp:
反対側を見上げると、クラスメイトの｛みずこし／水越｝｛まこ／眞子｝
がさげすむような目で、こちらを見ていた。
dialogues.en:
Looking up behind me, it's my classmate, Mizukoshi Mako,
glaring at us with scornful eyes.
dialogues.text:
Looking up behind me, it's my classmate, Mizukoshi Mako,
glaring at us with scornful eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「俺をこいつと一緒にするな眞子。俺はまとも
　だ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not with him, Mako. I'm an honest man."
dialogues.text: "I'm not with him, Mako. I'm an honest man."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何を言う、Ｍｙ同志・朝倉。共に戦った仲で
　はないか」
dialogues.en:
"What are you saying, comrade Asakura. Are we not
comrades-in-arms, fighting the same battle?"
dialogues.text:
"What are you saying, comrade Asakura. Are we not
comrades-in-arms, fighting the same battle?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いつ、どこで、何を、どうやって、誰が、な
　ぜ」
dialogues.en: "When, where, what, how, who, why?"
dialogues.text: "When, where, what, how, who, why?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「先週、ゲーセンで、ゾンビ退治を、ガンを使っ
　て、俺とお前が、教授の野望を阻止するため
　に」
dialogues.en:
"Last week, the arcade center, zombie extermination, using
guns, you and I, to prevent the evil ambitions of the
teachers."
dialogues.text:
"Last week, the arcade center, zombie extermination, using
guns, you and I, to prevent the evil ambitions of the
teachers."

dialogues.speaker: Asakura & Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「同志よ」
dialogues.en: "Comrades."
dialogues.text: "Comrades."

dialogues.jp: がっちりと腕を組み合う。
dialogues.en: Our palms firmly met each other's.
dialogues.text: Our palms firmly met each other's.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……どっちもバカ」
dialogues.en: "...in stupidity."
dialogues.text: "...in stupidity."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、席に着いて」
dialogues.en: "Alright, return to your seats."
dialogues.text: "Alright, return to your seats."

dialogues.jp:
本鈴と同時に、担任の｛しらかわこよみ／白河暦｝先生が教室に入っ
て来た。
dialogues.en:
As the bell went off, the form teacher Shirakawa Koyomi
arrived at the classroom.
dialogues.text:
As the bell went off, the form teacher Shirakawa Koyomi
arrived at the classroom.

dialogues.jp: ◆登校◆
dialogues.en: ◆Schooltime◆
dialogues.text: ◆Schooltime◆

dialogues.jp:
教室にやって来て、毎度のごとく、杉並辺りと
バカな話をする。
dialogues.en:
Upon entering the classroom, as usual, Suginami was nearby
spouting crap.
dialogues.text:
Upon entering the classroom, as usual, Suginami was nearby
spouting crap.

dialogues.jp:
そうこうするうち、チャイムが鳴って、担任の
白河暦先生が教室に入って来た。
dialogues.en:
Before he could go too far, the chime rang, and Shirakawa
Koyomi-sensei entered the classroom.
dialogues.text:
Before he could go too far, the chime rang, and Shirakawa
Koyomi-sensei entered the classroom.
